mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_upload (id, category, original_name, stored_name, mime_type, size, data, created_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.category}, #{row.originalName}, #{row.storedName}, #{row.mimeType}, #{row.size}, #{row.data,jdbcType=BLOB}, #{row.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, category, original_name, stored_name, mime_type, size, data, created_at FROM blog_upload WHERE id = #{id}
